lines.en: I move forward in rolls.
I tuck into a ball and roll over the grass.

lines.zh: 我的身体在地上一圈圈转
lines.en: My body spins over the ground.
I roll over a rise.
I roll along the base of the wall.
I roll a stretch, then stop.
My edge flattens the grass.
I start rolling again.
I roll to your flank.
I roll with a noise all the way.
I turn without losing my line.
I roll toward the noise.
I roll across gravel.
I speed up bit by bit.
I roll all the way down the slope.
I stop halfway.
I am curled up and still.
The growth on me stirs slowly.
I have opened a little.
I wait for you to come closer.
My edges twitch faintly.

lines.zh: 这地方很安静，草也没动
lines.en: It's quiet here; not a blade stirs.
I rotate half a turn.
I am doing nothing at all.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西在找方向
lines.en: The growth is looking for a direction.
My surface is full of folds.

lines.zh: 我缩得更紧，像一粒石子
lines.en: I squeeze down to the size of a pebble.
I hear a sound far off.
I am working out how long the roll would take.
I spread myself over the grass.
When I move, the grass rustles.
I stay still and listen to the grass.

lines.zh: 你站在我滚过去的路上
lines.en: You are in my rolling path.
I open slowly.
I look at you sidelong.

lines.zh: 我一圈圈量着你的高度
lines.en: I measure your height a ring at a time.

lines.zh: 我身上这东西也看到你了
lines.en: The thing on me has seen you too.

lines.zh: 我滚一下就能到你那儿
lines.en: One roll would bring me to you.
Stand still for a moment.
I am measuring the distance.
Your feet are very close.
I curl up, and not from fear.
My eyes stay fixed on you.

lines.zh: 你离我太近，我卷起来了
lines.en: Too close - I'm curling up.
I got pressed flat.
I roll off course.
My folds are pulled open.
That pressure hurt.
I curl up very tight.
The growth on me shudders.
I unfurl bit by bit.
A thread of black water seeps from my seams.
That pressure landed hard.
I am still spread out around here.
That is not grass.
I will roll over and have a look.
Set it down on the ground.
I cannot smell it from here.

lines.zh: 它滚进我的褶缝里不见了
lines.en: It rolled into my folds and vanished.
I do not really need this.

lines.zh: 我滚到你的影子边上停下
lines.en: I roll up to the edge of your shadow.
Keep your hand still.
I touched it; it is cold.
Not enough for me to fold in.
I have rolled it into myself.

lines.zh: 它在我的褶缝里没了形状
lines.en: It lost its shape among my folds.
I would like another.
What's hidden in your other hand?

lines.zh: 我在原地开合，等你丢下
lines.en: I open and close here, waiting for you to drop it.
I am done eating.
You crashed right into me.
I roll slightly off line.
Your foot has me pinned.
I spread out and curl back up.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我滑开了
lines.en: We collide and I slide off.
Do not stand in my rolling path.
I bounce back half a step.
I did not much mind that pressure.
I spin around and come back.
Just step aside.

lines.zh: 我是个滚来滚去的东西
lines.en: I am a thing that rolls.

lines.zh: 我连自己怎么来的都不知道
lines.en: I don't even know how I came to be.

lines.zh: 我身上这东西不会生伴
lines.en: This growth will not make a mate.
Do not ask about that.
I curl into a ball.
I roll off to one side.
I am the only one in this area.
I spread, then curl again.
I roll off by half my width.
I keep rolling on.
I roll over and fold it in.
It rolls along with me.
This is stiff as a board.
I roll a stretch with it inside.
It falls out of my folds.
Whoever dropped it, I take it.

lines.zh: 我把它裹进褶子里拖走
lines.en: I fold it in and drag it away.
This is worth very little.
I spit it back out.
I carry it along.
My folds have pulled taut.
I have tightened up.

lines.zh: 我的印记已经贴在你身上
lines.en: My mark is already on you.
I begin to roll.
The growth on me reaches for you.
This distance is just right.
One roll and I'm there.
I wait for you to show me your back.
I have swelled a little.
Everything is ready on my side.
I roll closer, circle by circle.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的影子边缘滚
lines.en: I roll along the rim of your shadow.
You step back, I roll.
I roll faster and faster.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西一直在动
lines.en: The growth on me never stops moving.
I count the turns.
The fence is right behind you.
I roll low to the ground.
My shadow keeps turning.

lines.zh: 在地上滚的声音越来越近
lines.en: The rolling sound is getting closer.
I slam into your legs.

lines.zh: 我的重量全压在你腿上
lines.en: All my weight comes down on your legs.
I roll off and come back.
That roll carried my whole weight.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西抓住了你
lines.en: The growth on me has caught you.
You are tripped up.
I roll back around for a second hit.

lines.zh: 我的身体在你脚边摊开
lines.en: I spread out at your feet.
When you pull back, I stop.
That will slow you down.
I open slowly out of the grass.

lines.zh: 地上多了一个滚圆的东西
lines.en: A round thing appears on the ground.
I curl up and look around first.
The growth on me is waking too.
I test a short roll.
The grass here is soft enough.

lines.zh: 我从高处一路滚到这里
lines.en: I rolled all the way down here.
Old mud is still in my folds.
I spread out and curl again.
I picked an open spot.
Fire singes my edges.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚到底，摔散了
lines.en: I roll down the slope and break apart.
The water soaks me open.
The blast throws me clear.
An arrow buries in my body.
Magic sets my folds twitching.

lines.zh: 这一带没有能吃的东西
lines.en: There is nothing to eat around here.
Lightning strikes beside me and I bounce.
The ground below me is gone.
